items.title: Ethereum Test Network Raises Block Limit to Over 3x Its Current Capacity
items.body: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.

items.title: Will AI Break Crypto Encryption? Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin Weighs In on 'Bunker Mode' Shift
items.body: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin thinks the crypto industry needs to make sure encryption is both quantum and AI-resistant.

items.title: Morning Minute: AI Could Break Crypto Encryption Before Quantum, Says Ethereum Researcher
items.body: Justin Drake is calling for crypto holders to start calmly planning for “Bunker Mode." But reactions so far haven’t been too calm.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test runs near 200 million gas per block after upgrade
items.body: The Sepolia rehearsal has raised its processing budget more than threefold, but sampled blocks used less than half that allowance.

items.title: Ethereum Researcher Says AI May Break Encryption Before Quantum Does
items.body: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged holders to calmly move funds to unused addresses, warning that AI-driven math could break crypto signatures before quantum computers do.

items.title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
